scope: Avoid a second escaped string for large quote-free array fields while writing backup CSV
eligibility: At least 1024 UTF-16 code units, first character [, last character ], at least one comma, and no double quote. The leading [ cannot trigger spreadsheet formula protection, and the comma requires CSV quoting. Emit quote, original string, quote to the existing writer.
fallback: All other fields use the unchanged escape() implementation. Escaping/unescaping, formula protection, schema, UTF-8 encoding, ZIP buffering and flushes remain unchanged.

measurement_method.runtime: JDK21 Windows host, Robolectric SDKs31/37; calling-thread allocated heap bytes and wall/CPU nanoseconds
measurement_method.method: Actual old/current compiled DataExporter.writeRoads, both invoked reflectively; 1000 SQLite road rows with 400-coordinate geometry each, including formula/quoted/Unicode names. Finish the ZIP and compare every byte; only fixture entry times are fixed to zero.
measurement_method.samples: Six warmup pairs, eleven alternating before/after rounds, per-fixture medians

tradeoff.work: One eligibility test per field and two additional buffered quote writes per qualifying field; no new buffer, cache, timer, persistent state or flush.
tradeoff.small_control: 10000 rows, nine ordinary/quoted/formula/Unicode fields each: allocation unchanged; median host wall time increases by 0.266 ms on SDK31 and 0.3296 ms on SDK37. This tiny cost is accepted for eliminating large field copies. No global zero-cost or speed claim.

csv_cases.coverage: Exact UTF-16 escaped text and parser/unescape round trips across size thresholds, missing commas, quotes, CR/LF, formula prefixes, apostrophes, Unicode format/control characters and surrogate code units. Existing large geometry writer assertion now requires the original field length rather than an assembled quoted field.

rejected_experiment.name: Direct road-update argument-array construction
rejected_experiment.status: Fully reverted before final validation; complete TrackingRepository matches baseline.
rejected_experiment.reason: Only about 33 KB saved per 100 short-road saves, without a convincing timing improvement. The gain was too small to justify keeping it.

limits: The kept change only reduces temporary export allocation for qualifying fields. It does not reduce archive size, stored history, provider calls or quota use.
Calling-thread JVM allocation and host timing are not Android peak RAM, native compression allocation, physical battery life or fleet-capacity measurements.
The CPU clock is coarse; zero means below resolution. Whole-ZIP timing does not establish a reliable speed improvement.
GPS capture, matching, distance, road identity, town geometry, schema, restore validation, server/gateway and other production code are unchanged. No additional storage deletion was selected.
Fresh-head CI is tracked separately in the draft PR.
